purpose: Remote knowledge, brush assets, runtime contracts, and delivery templates for $brush-creator-studio

entrypoints.procreate_workflow_template: templates/Procreate/柔彩小熊原稿｜Procreate 新笔刷绘画操作流程.xlsx

resolver_policy: Resolve exact repository paths from registries; do not guess asset paths.
User-provided current artwork is the primary project evidence; repository data is reusable workflow and brush evidence.
Do not infer or invent Procreate brush parameters from filenames alone.
Treat .brushset files as Git LFS assets; a Git blob may be an LFS pointer rather than the brushset binary.
Only label parameters or brush behavior as verified when supported by extracted evidence or real software testing.
Do not require the user to repeatedly upload artist/process/brush data already present in this repository.
For Mode B deliveries, read the registered Procreate workflow XLSX template and use its structure/style as the acceptance baseline for the generated painting-operation workflow workbook.
If the repository or manifest cannot be read, report KB_UNAVAILABLE and continue only with explicitly provided local inputs.
